title: Zero-memory reincarnation canary
mission: Prove that a completely fresh ChatGPT worker can recover the parent Chat Object and its governing requirements from durable Prometeo state, record STARTED, produce a durable return, mark DONE, and require no copied parent transcript or result transport.
why: This is the observed one-worker cycle required before scaling to the six-worker parallel batch. It gives the human evidence that forgetting/closing the current conversation does not destroy the operating state.
execution_steps: Load stable entry/runtime/constitution and this exact JOB.
Do not use or ask for the parent conversation transcript.
Create the exact run file `coordination/workstreams/chat-native-control-plane-v1/work-items/WI-ZM-01/runs/RUN-ZM-01-A.json` with state STARTED before doing the substantive recovery check.

Recover the parent Chat Object from durable files and identify: chat_object_id, mission, current frontier, first full batch id/status, the rule that Inbox is secondary, the rule for worker lifecycle feedback, and at least five survival invariants that would prevent memory loss/regression.
Verify that no current run/return evidence falsely claims the six-worker batch already ran.

Create durable return at `coordination/workstreams/chat-native-control-plane-v1/work-items/WI-ZM-01/returns/RUN-ZM-01-A.json` using the delegated return contract. Include the recovered facts and refs, and explicitly state whether the old transcript was needed.
Fetch the run file you created and update it to DONE with return_ref only after the return is durable.
Do not edit the parent Work Board, FOCUS, blueprint, bootstrap or shared runtime; the parent will observe and integrate the canary.
must_preserve: Human sends only the short launch command.
STARTED is durable before substantive recovery.
Worker writes only its own run/return subtree.
Facts and candidate recommendations remain separate.
Do not claim the six-worker batch ran merely because it is dispatchable.
success_criteria: Run file exists and shows STARTED before return timestamp.
Return exists and identifies the parent durable Chat Object and current frontier from external state.
Return confirms parent transcript was not required.
Return accurately reports B-CHATOBJ-01 as prepared/dispatchable but not yet executed unless new evidence appeared after job creation.
Run finishes DONE and points to the durable return.
No parent-owned files were modified by this worker.
done_when: The exact run and return files exist durably and the run is DONE, allowing the parent to verify the canary without the human copying the worker response.
stop_only_if: GitHub write permission or required stable Prometeo sources cannot be loaded. If blocked after STARTED, update the run to BOUNDARY with the exact reason instead of pretending success.
